# Vendored view libraries

Served at `/view/assets/` (src/dtest/api_service/app.py) so the artifact pages
work without a CDN inside the closed network. Copied unchanged from the
npm packages; each file keeps its license header.

| File | Package | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| marked.min.js | marked 12.0.2 | MIT |
| purify.min.js | dompurify 3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 |
| highlight.min.js | @highlightjs/cdn-assets 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| github.min.css | @highlightjs/cdn-assets 11.9.0 (styles/github.min.css) | BSD-3-Clause |
